aggregateSchemas.scope: 2024 Second Amendment / Forms 8, 10, 11 and 18 field intelligence
Contains schemas for Form 1 (DHA-1756), Form 2 (DHA-1714A), Form 3 (DHA-26) and Form 4 (DHA-TC-01)

notes: DHA_Forms/DHA-1740 is retained as a legacy aggregate for compatibility; its current content is Forms 1–4, not a standalone DHA-1740 Form 9.
Normalised standalone schemas for Forms 1–4 are now available as DHA_Forms/DHA-1756, DHA_Forms/DHA-1714A, DHA_Forms/DHA-26 and DHA_Forms/DHA-TC-01.
A true DHA-1740/Form 9 schema has not been created because the repository source reviewed in this pass did not contain an authoritative standalone Form 9 schema.
The individual constructed schemas are semantic field specifications and are not authorised for PDF generation until the exact source PDF and coordinate map are verified.
The canonical DHA-84 coordinate map remains under app/knowledgebase to avoid two independent coordinate-map sources drifting apart.
